d: The Fashion Advisor is responsible in contributing to the store sales by providing a remarkable and memorable service to all clients and maintain merchandising standards.
q: 1 to 5 years of experience equivalent position in the high-end retail fashion industry
Team oriented with proper conflict management skills
Fluency in spoken and written English
r: Promote high customer service standards throughout the shopping experience
Actively seek inputs from customers and efficiently address complaints to reinforce service standards
Gather information and organize records on customer preferences and buying behavior and provide proper feedback on tendencies.
Inform clients with needed policies and procedures to ensure transparency; including and not limited to refund and exchange policies
Provide support in VIP events and ensure proper follow up with clients as needed
Meet and maximize cross selling & up selling sales targets
Adhere to the standards of operations
Support the manager in achieving the Boutique’s goal
Ensure security procedures for merchandise are observed at all stages in the sale process.
Ensure a proper replenishment of merchandise, display and visual merchandising standards to maintain the brand’s image
Process accurately and efficiently cash register operations from opening to closing and protect company assets.
Efficiently support in efficient cost allocation by optimally using Boutique products & not exceeding availability

q: Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in legal affairs, preferably specializing in Saudi Labor Law and litigation.
Must hold a valid and active Saudi Lawyer's License.
Proven experience in litigation and representing clients before labor courts.
Solid knowledge of internal investigation procedures and labor dispute resolution.
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
Strong legal drafting, communication, and negotiation skills.
Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
Full fluency in spoken and written English.
r: Strong knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and relevant internal policies and procedures.
Represent the company before labor courts, attend court hearings, and prepare legal pleadings and submissions.
Conduct internal investigations and prepare detailed reports in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
Review, draft, and negotiate contracts and agreements to ensure legal compliance and protect the company's interests.
Provide legal advice and support to management and the HR department on employee-related matters and labor disputes.
Follow up on legal notices, claims, and court cases, and coordinate with external legal entities when necessary.
Review employment contracts, termination decisions, disciplinary actions, and other HR-related legal matters.
Monitor updates to relevant laws and regulations and advise management on their potential impact.
Prepare legal opinions, reports, and recommendations to support management in decision-making.
Maintain accurate records of legal cases, documentation, contracts, and correspondence.
